question.prompt: If \((m-1)x^{|m|}+3=0\) is a linear equation in the variable \(x\), find the value of \(m\).

solutions.explanation: The degree of \(x\) is 1, so \(|m|=1\), giving \(m=1\) or \(-1\). Also, the coefficient of the linear term must satisfy \(m-1\ne0\), so \(m\ne1\). Thus, \(m=-1\) is the only possibility.
solutions.title: Require degree 1 and a nonzero coefficient
